hits.title: Eliciting the Recall Capacity of Linear Attention
hits.abstract_snippet: Linear attention models exhibit a disproportionate deficit relative to softmax attention in associative recall (AR) in language modeling. We investigate this gap through natural language evaluations, synthetic recall tasks, and targeted training interventions. hits.title: Polynomial-Time Learning of Random Automata from One Label per Word
hits.abstract_snippet: We study a binary deterministic finite automaton whose $2n$ transitions are chosen independently and uniformly from its $n$ states. hits.title: Positive Geometry of Oriented Matroid Strata
hits.abstract_snippet: We study the positive geometry of Grassmannians whose boundary is a union of Plücker divisors. For the full Plücker boundary the regions are closures of realization spaces of uniform oriented matroids.
